tasks.title: Commit, release, expiry job
tasks.description: Same quadruple UPDATE. Advisory tombstone lock (ADR-007) before commit/release resolve the saga; consult tombstone first (410 OPERATION_RETIRED). Expiry worker 30s batch 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Commit-vs-expire exclusive. Commit/release CONFLICT is retryable deadlock and preserves the prior durable state (normally RESERVED or COMMITTED), never PENDING. Live terminal incompatible command is 409 OPERATION_STATE_CONFLICT retryable=false (never re-POST). STOCK_COMMIT_EXTERNAL not SALE.
acceptance_criteria: AC-STK-4: commit/release/expiry mutually exclusive; commit/release acquire the quadruple advisory lock and consult tombstone before saga FOR UPDATE; CONFLICT preserves the prior durable state (normally RESERVED/COMMITTED), never PENDING; POST commit/release with tombstone is 410 OPERATION_RETIRED
AC-STK-7: live terminal incompatible command is 409 OPERATION_STATE_CONFLICT retryable=false (GET returns terminal; never re-POST); tombstone is 410 OPERATION_RETIRED
GATE: state machine tests pass
